messages:
Maya - Marketing: Need a compact visual pack for next Tues launch: 1) hero 16:9 (headline + 2 screenshots), 2) benchmark microtile 1:1 showing 2.3x cost improvement + latency sparkline, 3) single A4 cheat-sheet for SDRs (callouts + HubSpot field mock). Can design deliver by Mon EOD?

Owen (Design): Yes. Send exact copy and the benchmark numbers. Prefer bars + sparkline for clarity. Will use pattern overlays for colorblind accessibility.

Maya - Marketing: Headline: "Predictable latency. Lower inference cost." Bench: median latency 55ms @2k tokens; cost 2.3x lower with prefix cache+batching. HubSpot queue: "Inbound - Bench Launch" fields: company, monthly tokens bracket, vertical, demo priority.

Priya (Growth): For SDR cheat-sheet add 1-line script and routing rules by token bracket.

Diego - Sales: Add "What we ask on demo" checklist (3 bullets).

FigmaBot: Frames queued: hero@16:9, microtile@1:1, cheatsheet@A4. ETA 3h.

DesignOps Bot: Brand-check pass but reduce microtile copy weight at small sizes.

Owen (Design): Got it. Uploading drafts here when ready.

Maya - Marketing: Thanks — will review and flag edits tomorrow morning.
